summary: Implemented the Copilot run end to end (scaffold, session through driver.Runner, transcript, trace, regex/tool_used/file_exists graders, report.json, table); the gate fails at one clause that no unrounded score can satisfy.
verified: vloop task gate T2 exited 1 at o1's 7/11 clause; go test ./internal/driver ./tools/..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l ., go mod tidy -diff and the linux and windows builds pass.
notes: Driver options, both defaulting to today's behaviour: Runner.Transcript (writes the session's stdout as printed to that file) and Runner.HookBinary (the binary a Copilot fence hook runs; copilotAdapter.hook, os.Executable() when empty); tested in internal/driver/agent_copilot_test.go. The tool: runner.go (execute, runOnce, table), trace.go (Copilot events to the trace, tool-name map), graders.go. Not built yet, deliberately honest: an llm grader makes the run an error 'judge failed: <grader>: the llm grader is not built yet' (T3 replaces it), and --agent claude cases error with 'claude sessions are not built yet' (T4 replaces it). Gate dispute: the gate compares fixture-graders' run score to awk 'BEGIN { print 7 / 11 }', which prints 0.636364 (OFMT %.6g, checked on this machine), with a 1e-9 tolerance; the report carries the unrounded 0.6363636363636364 as the brief's 'unrounded mean' requires, so the difference is 3.6e-7. Only a score rounded to six digits passes, which I did not write. The gate clauses after that one (run folder, argv, plugin dir, hook, table, total, --runs 2, plan hash, o3, o4, no result, timeout) were not reached by the gate; my Go tests cover those behaviours with their own fake copilot. The operator should compare with tolerance 1e-6, or against jq's own 7/11.

gate_dispute.reason: The gate compares the score to awk's six-digit print of 7/11 with a 1e-9 tolerance, which an unrounded score cannot meet; the brief requires the unrounded mean.
gate_dispute.evidence: Clause near "$(q "$R" "$RUN | .score")" "$(awk 'BEGIN { print 7 / 11 }')" fails: awk prints 0.636364, the report holds 0.6363636363636364, and |difference| = 3.6e-7 > 1e-9.
